• The trailer for বন্ধুরা পাশে থাকলে #EbhabeoPhireAshaJaye dropped October 08, 2026.

The makers of বন্ধুরা পাশে থাকলে #EbhabeoPhireAshaJaye have released the official trailer, unveiled October 08, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to theaters.
